inputs.name: drive_min_nyc
inputs.curve: drive_min_nyc: lower is better; scores 1 at 60 min or less, falling in a straight line to 0 at 240 min.

inputs.name: drive_min_regional_hub
inputs.curve: drive_min_regional_hub: lower is better; scores 1 at 15 min or less, falling in a straight line to 0 at 90 min.

inputs.name: miles_to_rail_station
inputs.curve: miles_to_rail_station: lower is better; scores 1 at 2 mi or less, falling in a straight line to 0 at 30 mi.

inputs.name: pre1940_share
inputs.curve: pre1940_share: higher is better; scores 1 at 0.6 or more, falling in a straight line to 0 at 0.1.

inputs.name: has_nrhp_district
inputs.curve: has_nrhp_district: 1 when a National Register historic district lies within the place, otherwise 0.

inputs.name: osm_business_per_1k
inputs.curve: osm_business_per_1k: higher is better; scores 1 at 20 per 1,000 or more, falling in a straight line to 0 at 2 per 1,000.

inputs.name: median_home_value
inputs.curve: median_home_value divided by metro_median_home_value. price ratio to the metro median: cheapest is not best: a town priced well below its metro has headroom, one priced far below it has no demand yet, and one at or above it has already been found; scores 1 at 0.6, and 0 at or below 0.25 and at or above 1.2, with straight lines between.

inputs.name: broadband_subscription_share
inputs.curve: broadband_subscription_share: higher is better; scores 1 at 0.9 or more, falling in a straight line to 0 at 0.5.

inputs.name: under_18_share
inputs.curve: under_18_share: higher is better; scores 1 at 0.25 or more, falling in a straight line to 0 at 0.12.

inputs.name: hospital_within_20min
inputs.curve: hospital_within_20min: 1 when a hospital is within a 20-minute drive, otherwise 0.

inputs.name: dri_award_amount
inputs.curve: dri_award_amount: higher is better; scores 1 at 1e+07 USD or more, falling in a straight line to 0 at 0 USD.

inputs.name: dri_award_year
inputs.curve: dri_award_year: 1 when the award is at most 3 years old, fading in a straight line to 0.3 at 10 years and staying there.

inputs.name: zhvi_change_1y
inputs.curve: zhvi_change_1y minus zhvi_change_1y_ny_median. one-year home value change against the typical New York place: higher is better; scores 1 at 5 percentage points or more, falling in a straight line to 0 at -5 percentage points.

inputs.name: permit_rate_change
inputs.curve: permit_rate_change: higher is better; scores 1 at 2 units per 1,000 residents a year or more, falling in a straight line to 0 at -2 units per 1,000 residents a year.

inputs.name: population_change
inputs.curve: population_change minus population_change_ny_median. population change since 2020 against the typical New York place: higher is better; scores 1 at 3 percentage points or more, falling in a straight line to 0 at -3 percentage points.

suppression.text: Any American Community Survey figure whose margin of error exceeds 40% of the estimate is kept but marked suppressed: it is shown as not available at this sample size and excluded from the score. Permit rates are suppressed when any of the three years was reported for fewer than twelve months.

median_home_value.label: Median home value
median_home_value.description: Median value of owner-occupied homes (ACS 5-year, B25077).

zhvi.label: Zillow home value index
zhvi.description: Zillow's typical home value for the place, latest month with a value.

zori.label: Zillow observed rent
zori.description: Zillow's typical asking rent for the place, latest month with a value.

zhvi_change_1y.label: Home value change, one year
zhvi_change_1y.description: Zillow home value index, latest month against the same month a year earlier.

zhvi_change_1y_ny_median.label: Typical NY place home value change
zhvi_change_1y_ny_median.description: Median one-year change in the Zillow home value index across every New York place in the file. The momentum benchmark.

zori_change_1y.label: Rent change, one year
zori_change_1y.description: Zillow observed rent index, latest month against the same month a year earlier. Shown, not scored, because Zillow publishes it for few villages.

zori_change_1y_ny_median.label: Typical NY place rent change
zori_change_1y_ny_median.description: Median one-year change in the Zillow observed rent index across every New York place in the file.

drive_min_nyc.label: Drive to New York City
drive_min_nyc.description: Routed driving time to Grand Central Terminal, off-peak (OSRM over OpenStreetMap).

osm_business_count.label: Main street businesses
osm_business_count.description: Shops, restaurants, offices, crafts and lodging mapped in OpenStreetMap inside the place boundary.

permit_units.label: Housing units permitted
permit_units.description: Residential units permitted in the year (Census Building Permits Survey).

vacancy_rate.label: Vacant housing share
vacancy_rate.description: Vacant housing units over all units (ACS 5-year, B25002).

pre1940_share.label: Homes built before 1940
pre1940_share.description: Share of housing units built in 1939 or earlier (ACS 5-year, B25034).

broadband_subscription_share.label: Broadband subscription
broadband_subscription_share.description: Households with a cable, fiber-optic or DSL subscription (ACS 5-year, B28002). Not a speed measure.

poverty_rate.label: Poverty rate
poverty_rate.description: People below the poverty line (ACS 5-year, B17001).

commute_60plus_share.label: Commutes over an hour
commute_60plus_share.description: Workers whose commute is 60 minutes or more (ACS 5-year, B08303).

k12_enrollment.label: K-12 enrollment
k12_enrollment.description: Residents enrolled in nursery through grade 12 (ACS 5-year, B14001).

under_18_share.label: Share under 18
under_18_share.description: Residents under 18 over total population (ACS 5-year, B09001 / B01003).

cbsa_median_home_value.label: Metro area median home value
cbsa_median_home_value.description: ACS 5-year, B25077, for the metropolitan or micropolitan area.

metro_median_home_value.label: Metro median home value
metro_median_home_value.description: The metro-area median where the town lies in one, otherwise the county median.

population_change.label: Population change since 2020
population_change.description: Census population estimates, 2020 base to the latest year.

population_change_ny_median.label: Typical NY place population change
population_change_ny_median.description: Median change since 2020 across every New York place in the estimates file. The momentum benchmark.

permit_months_reported.label: Months reported
permit_months_reported.description: Months of permit data the place reported in the year.

permits_per_1k.label: Units permitted per 1,000 residents
permits_per_1k.description: Three-year mean of units permitted, per 1,000 residents.

permit_rate_change.label: Change in permit rate
permit_rate_change.description: The latest three-year permit rate, in units per 1,000 residents a year, minus the three-year rate ending two years earlier.

nrhp_district_count.label: Historic districts
nrhp_district_count.description: National Register historic districts within the place boundary.

has_nrhp_district.label: Historic district present
has_nrhp_district.description: Whether a National Register historic district lies within the place.

miles_to_rail_station.label: Nearest rail station
miles_to_rail_station.description: Straight-line distance to the nearest Amtrak or Metro-North station.

drive_min_regional_hub.label: Drive to nearest regional hub
drive_min_regional_hub.description: Routed driving time to the nearest of Albany, Utica, Poughkeepsie, Kingston, Newburgh, Middletown or White Plains.

drive_min_nearest_hospital.label: Drive to nearest hospital
drive_min_nearest_hospital.description: Routed driving time to the nearest hospital (NYS Department of Health list).

hospital_within_20min.label: Hospital within 20 minutes
hospital_within_20min.description: Whether the nearest hospital is a 20-minute drive or less.

crow_miles_nyc.label: Straight-line miles to NYC
crow_miles_nyc.description: Great-circle distance to Grand Central Terminal.

crow_miles_regional_hub.label: Straight-line miles to nearest hub
crow_miles_regional_hub.description: Great-circle distance to the nearest regional hub.

dri_award_count.label: State downtown awards
dri_award_count.description: Downtown Revitalization Initiative and NY Forward awards won.

dri_award_amount.label: Latest downtown award
dri_award_amount.description: Amount of the most recent DRI or NY Forward award; zero when none.

dri_award_year.label: Latest award year
dri_award_year.description: Year the most recent DRI or NY Forward round was announced.
